question: Which repeat customers from the last 6 months with more than ₹5L outstanding haven't been contacted in 30 days, and which products are they buying?
notes: repeat = 2+ invoices in the last 6 months; outstanding = unpaid balance on all invoices; contact = any CRM activity. 4 decoys owe as much but were contacted recently; one answer shares its name with another customer.
reference_sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) n FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_date >= date(:as_of, '-6 months') GROUP BY customer_id),
owed AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(balance) outstanding FROM invoice_balance GROUP BY customer_id),
touch AS (SELECT a.erp_customer_id cid, MAX(substr(t.occurred_at, 1, 10)) last
FROM crm.activities t JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.erp_customer_id)
SELECT r.customer_id FROM recent r JOIN owed o USING (customer_id)
LEFT JOIN touch ON touch.cid = r.customer_id
WHERE r.n >= 2 AND o.outstanding > 500000 AND (touch.last IS NULL OR touch.last < date(:as_of, '-30 days'))

question: Which SKUs did our top 10 customers buy, and what was their NPS when they bought?
notes: top 10 by total invoiced; the 10 enterprise accounts are far ahead under any time window. NPS 'when they bought' = nearest survey before/around the purchase.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show me customers who started with small orders (<₹1L) but grew to >₹5L, their sales rep, and when they're due for a check-in.
notes: started = first invoice by date < ₹1L; grew = a later invoice > ₹5L. Check-in due = last activity + account checkin_cadence_days.
reference_sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT customer_id, total_amount FROM invoices i
WHERE invoice_date = (SELECT MIN(invoice_date) FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = i.customer_id))
SELECT customer_id FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING MAX(total_amount) > 500000
AND (SELECT MIN(total_amount) FROM firsts f WHERE f.customer_id = invoices.customer_id) < 100000

question: Which vendors have improved payment timeliness in the last 3 months, and which invoices drove that change?
notes: days late = paid_on - bill_due_date on purchase_orders; improved = recent average at least 10 days better than the prior 9 months. 3 decoy vendors got worse.
reference_sql: SELECT vendor_id FROM purchase_orders
WHERE paid_on IS NOT NULL AND bill_due_date >= date(:as_of, '-12 months')
GROUP BY vendor_id
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN bill_due_date >= date(:as_of, '-3 months')
THEN julianday(paid_on) - julianday(bill_due_date) END)
<= AVG(CASE WHEN bill_due_date < date(:as_of, '-3 months')
THEN julianday(paid_on) - julianday(bill_due_date) END) - 10

question: Customers with 3+ unpaid invoices — show me the reason codes and when they last engaged with sales.
notes: unpaid = invoice with a balance (unpaid or partial). Some reason codes are NULL (not recorded).
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM invoice_balance WHERE balance > 0 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

question: Find dormant customers (no purchase in 6+ months) who spent >₹10L historically and calculate win-back opportunity.
notes: dormant = last invoice older than 6 months; lifetime spend > ₹10L. Small dormant customers are decoys. Some have open win_back opportunities in CRM.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING MAX(invoice_date) < date(:as_of, '-6 months') AND SUM(total_amount) > 1000000

question: List all our customers based in Pune.
notes: Single-table lookup. Two Pune customers share their names with customers in other cities.
reference_sql: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE city = 'Pune'

question: How much did we invoice in total over the last 12 months?
notes: Sum of invoices.total_amount in the window, any payment status.
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= date(:as_of, '-12 months')

question: How much money do customers currently owe us on overdue invoices?
notes: Balance after payments (part payments count) on invoices past their due date.
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(balance), 2) FROM invoice_balance WHERE balance > 0 AND days_past_due > 0

question: Which 5 SKUs brought in the most revenue in the last 6 months?
notes: Revenue = SUM(line_items.amount) by invoice date.
reference_sql: SELECT li.sku FROM line_items li JOIN invoices i ON i.id = li.invoice_id
WHERE i.invoice_date >= date(:as_of, '-6 months')
GROUP BY li.sku ORDER BY SUM(li.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which products are below their reorder level, and which vendor supplies each?
notes: stock_qty < reorder_level; supplier from inventory.vendor_id.
reference_sql: SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE stock_qty < reorder_level

question: Which sales rep owns the most Strategic-tier accounts?
notes: CRM-only question.
reference_sql: SELECT owner_rep FROM crm.accounts WHERE tier = 'Strategic' GROUP BY owner_rep ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which Enterprise customers gave a detractor NPS score (6 or below) in the last 6 months?
notes: Segment lives in ERP, NPS in CRM: needs an ID hand-off.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.erp_customer_id FROM crm.nps_responses n
JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.id = n.account_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = a.erp_customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND n.score <= 6 AND n.responded_on >= date(:as_of, '-6 months')

question: Which customers have an open sales opportunity but haven't placed an order in the last 90 days?
notes: open = stage prospecting/proposal/negotiation. CRM prospects with no ERP record are not customers. Two customers have duplicate CRM accounts.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.erp_customer_id FROM crm.opportunities o JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
WHERE o.stage IN ('prospecting', 'proposal', 'negotiation') AND a.erp_customer_id IS NOT NULL
AND (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = a.erp_customer_id) < date(:as_of, '-90 days')

question: Which 3 customers paid us furthest past the due date on average over the last 12 months? Count only fully paid invoices (at least 3 per customer) and use the final payment date.
notes: days late = final payment date - due_date, invoices dated in the last 12 months.
reference_sql: SELECT i.customer_id FROM invoices i
JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(paid_on) AS last_paid FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) p ON p.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.invoice_date >= date(:as_of, '-12 months')
GROUP BY i.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY AVG(julianday(p.last_paid) - julianday(i.due_date)) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How much does Vikas Machine Tools in Surat currently owe us?
notes: Trap: two customers are called 'Vikas Machine Tools' (Pune and Surat).
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.balance), 2) FROM invoice_balance b JOIN customers c ON c.id = b.customer_id
WHERE c.name = 'Vikas Machine Tools' AND c.city = 'Surat'

question: Which customers have given us a promoter NPS score (9 or 10) but currently have an overdue invoice?
notes: Promoter at any time; overdue = balance on an invoice past due.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.erp_customer_id FROM crm.nps_responses n JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.id = n.account_id
WHERE n.score >= 9 AND a.erp_customer_id IN
(SELECT customer_id FROM invoice_balance WHERE balance > 0 AND days_past_due > 0)

question: Which customers in Delhi owe us more than ₹1 crore?
notes: Correct answer is nobody. Tests that the agent says so instead of stretching.
reference_sql: SELECT c.id FROM customers c JOIN invoice_balance b ON b.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.city = 'Delhi' GROUP BY c.id HAVING SUM(b.balance) > 10000000

question: Which customers have had no sales activity logged in the last 200 days, including customers with no CRM record at all?
notes: Trap: 8 ERP customers have no CRM account and must be included; 2 customers have two CRM accounts (use the latest activity across both).
reference_sql: SELECT c.id FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.erp_customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN crm.activities t ON t.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY c.id HAVING MAX(t.occurred_at) IS NULL OR MAX(t.occurred_at) < date(:as_of, '-200 days')

question: Which vendors supply our top 3 SKUs by revenue over the last 12 months?
notes: Top SKUs from line_items, supplier from inventory.vendor_id.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id FROM inventory WHERE sku IN (
SELECT li.sku FROM line_items li JOIN invoices i ON i.id = li.invoice_id
WHERE i.invoice_date >= date(:as_of, '-12 months')
GROUP BY li.sku ORDER BY SUM(li.amount) DESC LIMIT 3)
